messages:
Anita R.: heads-up — proposing we switch the europe pool admit policy from hard-reject to proportional admit buckets + soft-degrade for CPU/GPU pressure. want quick feedback.
Kevin M.: can you sketch the behavioral differences? i assume some requests get slowed rather than rejected?
Anita R.: yep. instead of binary admit/reject we assign per-tenant bucket tokens proportional to commit tier and realtime load. when tokens exhausted we mark requests as 'soft-degraded' (lower batch priority + shorter kv-cache TTL) rather than immediate 503.
Maria S.: sounds promising. how do we avoid head-of-line blocking if degraded requests still consume slots?
Anita R.: degraded requests run on a slowpath pool with limited concurrency and preemptible queues. they only use leftover GPU cycles, and we preempt them for any fastpath traffic.
Oncall SRE: concern — network spikes to eu-west-1 last week spiked queueing. if slowpath floods it might raise p95 latency. do we have circuit breakers?
InfraBot: metric snapshot: eu-west-1 gpu-util=92%, queue-depth-90s=160, cpu-backed-slowpath-util=45% (as of 2024-05-28T14:02Z)
Kevin M.: we should include a hard cap: if slowpath queue depth > X or slowpath p95 > Y then auto-reject new slowpath admits. also expose a safety window for warmups.
Tom H.: cost question — estimated extra GPU cycles for soft-degrade under 95th load = ~6% on top of baseline (rough calc). can we surface per-tenant cost delta so finance is not surprised?
Maria S.: +1 on visibility. also we should test cold-start behaviour: degraded requests evict kv cache faster — need perf regression test.
Liz P.: rollout plan idea: 1) feature-flagged in eu-west-1, 2) 10% tenant canary (non-enterprise), 3) monitor p50/p95, cost delta, and errors for 48h, 4) auto-disable on thresholds. runbook will include manual revert and capacity bump steps.
Anita R.: sounds good. i'll draft the experiment config and PR. question for Kevin: want proportional weights to be a linear function of commit tier or log-scaled?
Kevin M.: start linear, iterate if we see noisy preemption. also add a small jitter to avoid sync expiries.
Oncall SRE: add alerting: slowpath_queue_depth > 200 for 5m and slowpath_p95 > 5s for 2m -> paging.
Liz P.: i'll author the rollout checklist and update incident playbook for this path.
Tom H.: ping finance for a quick FYI after PR, cc: @finance.
Anita R.: thanks all — i'll post the PR and initial configs here once ready. :thumbsup:
